```{r}
face_to_number <- function(x){
  if(x == "cara"){
    valor = 0
  }
  if(x == "coroa"){
    valor = 1
  }
  if(x == "cora"){
    valor = 1
  }
  
  return(valor)
}

face_to_number <- Vectorize(face_to_number)

moeda_1 <- moeda_1 %>% select("Ana_inicial" , "Ana_final", "Daniel_inicial", "Daniel_final", "Joao_inicial", "Joao_final", "Lucas_inicial", "Lucas_final") %>% drop_na() %>% mutate_all(str_to_lower) %>% mutate_all(face_to_number)

moeda_2 <- moeda_2 %>% select("Ana_inicial" , "Ana_final", "Daniel_inicial", "Daniel_final", "Joao_inicial", "Joao_final", "Lucas_inicial", "Lucas_final") %>% drop_na() %>% mutate_all(str_to_lower) %>% mutate_all(face_to_number)

moeda_3 <- moeda_3 %>% select("Ana_inicial" , "Ana_final", "Daniel_inicial", "Daniel_final", "Joao_inicial", "Joao_final", "Lucas_inicial", "Lucas_final") %>% drop_na() %>% mutate_all(str_to_lower) %>% mutate_all(face_to_number)

moeda_4 <- moeda_4 %>% select("Ana_inicial" , "Ana_final", "Daniel_inicial", "Daniel_final", "Joao_inicial", "Joao_final", "Lucas_inicial", "Lucas_final") %>% drop_na() %>% mutate_all(str_to_lower) %>% mutate_all(face_to_number)
```

```{r}
z_test <- function(x){
  n_suc = sum(x)
  p0 = 2/3
  n = length(x)
  if(n_suc > p0*n){
    stat = n_suc + 1/2 - p0*n
  }
  else{stat = n_suc - 1/2 - p0*n}
  
  z_stat  <- stat/sqrt(n*p0*(1-p0))
  p_value <- 2*pnorm(-abs(z_stat))
  
  vetor = c(p0*n, n_suc, z_stat, p_value)
  
  return(vetor)
}

z_test <- Vectorize(z_test)

z_test(moedas_df_3[,9:12])
```

```{r}
moedas_df_2$Moeda <- c(rep(1, 100), rep(2, 100), rep(3, 100), rep(4, 100))
names(moedas_df_2) <- c("Inicial", "Final", "Inicial", "Final", "Inicial", "Final", "Inicial", "Final", "Moeda")

moedas_df_long <- cbind(Inicial = c(moedas_df_2[,1], moedas_df_2[,3], moedas_df_2[,5], moedas_df_2[,7]), Final = c(moedas_df_2[,2], moedas_df_2[,4], moedas_df_2[,6], moedas_df_2[,8]), Moeda = moedas_df_2[,9]) %>% as.data.frame()
```

```{r}
moedas_grafico <- moedas_df_long %>% group_by(Inicial, Moeda) %>% summarise(Final = sum(Final), .groups = 'drop') %>% mutate(Inicial = ifelse(Inicial == 1, "Coroa", "Cara")) 
moedas_grafico$Final_2 <- (200 - moedas_grafico$Final)
moedas_grafico <- moedas_grafico %>% pivot_longer(c(Final, Final_2), names_to = "Face Final") %>% mutate(`Face Final` = ifelse(`Face Final` == "Final", "Coroa", "Cara"))
```

```{r}
labs_facet <- c("Moeda 1", "Moeda 2", "Moeda 3", "Moeda 4")
names(labs_facet) <- c("1", "2", "3", "4")

moedas_grafico %>% 
  ggplot(aes(x = Inicial, y = value, fill = `Face Final`))+
  geom_bar(stat = "identity", width=0.7, position = "Dodge")+
  facet_grid(~Moeda, labeller = labeller(Moeda = labs_facet))+
  labs(x = "Face Inicial", y = "Face Final")+
  theme_bw()
```
